description: Hand-authored ground truth for go-minimal synthetic fixture. Module path github.com/example/go-minimal, 2 packages (main, helpers), every edge enumerable. QN form is oracle-emit form: caller is fully-qualified `<project>.<file>.<func>`; callee is the syntactic call expression (`helpers.Greet` for cross-pkg, bare name `leaf` for same-pkg). Realigned 2026-05-03 from Go-import-path form to oracle-emit form as part of ACC-009 fix.

expected_caller_kind_invariants.rationale: Every caller is a free function body — no methods, no tests, no init(), no package-level var initializers, no closures. The kinds_present check is asserted by check_go_minimal_caller_kind.py against whatever sanitized-path QN form the indexer chooses; the kind property is what the gate verifies. Acts as the prove-the-instrument gate per verify-effectiveness.md before publishing real-fixture caller-kind metrics.

expected_resolver_rule_invariants.rationale: Every edge is a free-function call, no init(), no closures, no test bodies. The 4 same-package edges (entry->leaf, leaf->helper, main->entry, helpers.Greet->helpers.innerGreet) must classify as same-package-shadow (registry same_module strategy) or an LSP-resolved variant. The 1 cross-package edge (entry->helpers.Greet) must classify as one of the cross-package-heuristic family OR an LSP-resolved variant (exact-qn-match / receiver-qualified / interface-dispatch) depending on which pathway resolved it. fuzzy-resolve / unresolved-emitted / unknown indicate a resolver failure; modal-pseudo would mean the caller scope was lost; package-block-fallback is unused in current paths. Step 4 prove-the-instrument gate per verify-effectiveness.md.

expected_candidate_set_invariants.rationale: Every callee in this fixture is uniquely named project-wide (entry, leaf, helper, main, Greet, innerGreet — no duplicates) and every receiver is unambiguous (no methods on multiple struct types). Every CALLS edge therefore carries candidate_set_size=1. method_set_ambiguity_index = 0.0 because no call site has >= 2 candidates. janusian_site_precision_split has only the 'unambiguous' bucket populated; 'ambiguous' bucket support=0. We did NOT augment the fixture with a same-named-method case — the existing 5-edge ground truth would change shape (more expected edges) and risk regressing the resolver_rule and caller_kind gates. The candidate_set_test.go unit tests cover the multi-candidate signal directly (TestResolveCallEdge_SameNamedMethodOnTwoStructs_CandidateSetSizeTwo, TestResolveCallEdge_InterfaceSatisfactionTwoImpls_CandidateSetSizeAtLeastTwo). Step 5 prove-the-instrument gate per verify-effectiveness.md — verifies the property is populated on every edge and the index computes the expected value (0.0) on a known-unambiguous fixture.

notes: 5 internal CALLS, 1 internal IMPORTS. RTA resolves interface methods; we don't have any interfaces so RTA = CHA = static here. External imports (none explicit) excluded. ACC-009 (2026-05-03): GT realigned from Go-import-path form to oracle-emit form; oracle's doubled-package bug for non-main packages also fixed (helpers/helpers.go now emits go-minimal.helpers, not go-minimal.helpers.helpers). The accuracy-regression workflow's strict QN string equality check now passes.
